title: One Federation first-contact fields
description: Relationship and first-contact fields of the envelope. The relationship level is never carried: it is the recipient's own acceptance record and is evaluated only on the recipient's side. The first-contact token is not here either: it travels in the mailbox delivery metadata outside the encrypted content, where the mailbox verifies and consumes it.

firstContact.description: True when the sender has no established relationship with the recipient.

initiation.description: Why the sender opens first contact: the person's explicit request, or an explicit mandate of the person (allowed only towards organisation agents).

recipientPartyKind.description: Kind of party the recipient person identifier denotes, as resolved by the sender.
